{{Infobox furniture |image = Prairie King Arcade System |size = 48 |description = {{Description|Prairie King Arcade System}} |os = Beat [[Journey of the Prairie King]] |showheader = n }} The '''Prairie King Arcade System''' is an arcade game machine that allows the player to play [[Journey of the Prairie King]]. The day after beating the game in [[The Stardrop Saloon]], the player will receive a letter with their own Prairie King Arcade System attached. The arcade machine can be placed anywhere, indoors or out. If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}. ==Letter== {{Quote|Congratulations!!

You beat 'Journey Of The Prairie King', and were randomly selected in our exclusive winner's sweepstakes!

You've won a Prairie King Arcade System of your very own!

Now you can enjoy 'Journey Of The Prairie King' from the comfort of your own home.

You deserve it!.|Prairie King Development Team}} ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6.9|If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods.}} {{NavboxFurniture}} [[Category:Furniture]] [[de:Prärie-König-Spielautomat]] [[es:Máquina «Rey de la Pradera»]] [[fr:Jeu "Les aventures du roi de la prairie"]] [[it:Arcade 'Re della Prateria']] [[ja:ゲーム機（プレーリーキング）]] [[ko:대초원의 왕 게임기]] [[hu:Prairie King játékrendszer]] [[pt:Arcade do Rei da Pradaria]] [[ru:Игровая система «Король Прерий»]] [[tr:Çayır Kralı Atari Oyunu]] [[zh:草原之王街机系统]]
